authorship: handwritten from transition table column A + K2-b rules; not produced by a reducer/projector
notes: Trees and expected outcomes are authored literals; formatting helpers only serialize these literals.
T07 equality means the returned receipt equals T01; the active head remains its own initial head.
T18 after_send is a separate checkpoint: U does not exist in the approval-only state.
Rejected no-op operations do not enter internal nodes. Fixtures avoid an internal starting head for these rejection cases.
L and R are user messages after assistant H. T17 compares same-role user alternatives L/R/U but does not merge their distinct actual parents H/X.
T09b deletes unprotected sibling R while head stays L; stored e1 and X survive although e1 is inactive on L.
within_approved_branch: operation이 시작되는 head가 승인 anchor Xk 또는 그 하위 트리에 있고, operation이 그 하위 트리 안에서 끝나는가. 시작·종료 구조 경로에 공통 승인 anchor가 있으면 true이며, 승인 전의 최초 accept는 false다.
K5 검사 순서: (c) 같은 멱등 키 조회 → (a) 제안 분기 일치 → (b) 기대 head·상태 토큰 일치. 멱등 재요청은 (a)(b)보다 먼저 기존 결과를 반환한다.
K5 검사와 K7 검사가 동시에 실패할 때의 우선순서는 문서에 정해져 있지 않다. 이 fixture의 모든 거부 사례는 검사 하나만 실패하도록 구성했으며, 우선순서를 정하지 않는다.

T07/T07b are receipt lookups; recorded_approval_head describes the original T01 approval, not a new approval; current head LA is also a complete assistant satisfying K7. T12 is explicit return; recorded_approval_heads records the prior X1/X2 approvals.

gate_table is a handwritten condition table, audited against request inputs for new approvals; it does not execute a reducer or choose precedence. D1 deletion and K5 c replay conflicts are separate operation classes.

basis: K7: L → LA complete → XL → UL; select(L) stops at LA
